column1: # libraries.tsv - one row per prepared sequencing library (master plan 6.1)
# layout         paired | single. A paired library requires both mates in
#                reads.tsv and is never silently downgraded (IN02).
# assay_family   bulk | bulk_end_tag | ... see config/spec.yaml scope.assays
# strandedness   kit-declared value, e.g. ISR, SR, U. Compared with what
#                Salmon detects; a disagreement is resolved by policy (PR05).
# kit            exact kit and version. Required before an end-tag assay is
#                qualified (H18, V05); leave blank if genuinely unknown.
# prep_batch     library preparation batch, for QC06 batch diagnosis
# umi            no | yes | unknown; execution currently requires confirmed no.
# These are example records. Replace protocol declarations with your actual data.
